name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Therasage is a visionary company that binds health benefits into every sphere of life with the use of various Infrared applications in such casual things as furniture, clothing and bedding. Each product is made under expert supervision and with quality specifications, designed to withstand years of active use and supported by special warranties – this is the companies responsibility that reflects the passion and experience in sauna and other products Therasage manufactures.



Following a code of honest dealing, Therasage established codes of ethical conduct, conflicts of interest and privacy that each staff member follows, making their own effort to show the honesty and fairness of Therasage from the source of the materials used to the final distribution. Environmental care is reflected in energy efficient and renewable energy throughout all the products available at Therasage.



Infrared Home Sauna units are provided in a variety of sizes – they can be for one, two or three persons, and do not need any expensive installing, carpentry or plumbing. Comfortable and top quality, eco-friendly and hypo-allergenic, non-toxic and energy saving infrared sauna will bring all the available health benefits at your disposal with no problem.
